_backend_comment: 'sqlserver' (this install, fully tested) or 'access' (UNTESTED -- for a Busy install backed by MS Access instead of SQL Server; see access.file_path below and README.md's 'MS Access backend' section). Only the connection layer differs between the two -- the SQL/queries in sql_preflight.py and idempotency.py are assumed identical, since Busy's own schema should be the same either way, but this has never been verified against a real Access-backed Busy install.

access._comment: Only used when backend='access'. file_path is the real Busy .mdb/.accdb database file this install actually uses -- find it via Busy's own Company Info screen or ask whoever set up that Busy install.

sqlserver._comment: Real credentials (readonly user/password, and once created, writer user/password) go in config.local.json (gitignored), never here.
